author: marthomahew
name: dailygames
short: A morning recap of yesterday's daily game scores.
description: Reads members' Worldle, Maptap and DailyOrbs shares in the daily games channel and posts a recap of yesterday's scores each morning, right after the Wordle app's post (or at 10 AM Central). Admins can add simple-score games by replying to a share with `[p]dailygames learn`.
install_msg: Loaded? `[p]dailygames channel #daily-games`, then `[p]dailygames preview` to see the recap.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the daily game scores members post (who, which game, the score) for about a month, to show yesterday's results. It can be deleted on request.
